name: Shadow of Backrooms
detailed_description:
Shadow of the Backrooms - Your nightmare begins

Explore a dark world full of liminal rooms, abandoned corridors and surreal places. You will feel lost in the backrooms, wandering aimlessly through endless corridors and hoping to find a way out. But beware: you are not alone. How long can you survive? Will you find the exit - or get lost forever?

What awaits you

🕵️ Explore surreal environments - every corner holds new secrets.

🧩 Solve puzzles - The way out is full of challenges.

👁 Escape the unknown - Something lurks in the shadows.

📖 Discover the story - A story based on the backrooms that is developed further with each update.

Game modes

🎮 Single player mode

Immerse yourself in a menacing world and find your own way through the backrooms. Even if you are alone - you are being watched.

👥 Multiplayer mode (planned)

There is currently no multiplayer available, but if it is technically possible, you will soon be able to traverse the backrooms with friends.

About me

Hey! 👋 I'm not a professional developer, just a guy releasing his first game. I'm still learning and look forward to your feedback! If you find bugs, have suggestions or just want to share your opinion, feel free to write it in the comments. Your support means a lot to me! 😊
